english: A backpack you can set down and fill like a chest (48 slots).\nBreak it to pack it up: it drops as a Packed Storage Backpack with everything still inside. An empty one drops as itself.

A packed Storage Backpack. Everything that was in it is kept safe on the server.\nPlace it anywhere to unpack it. It can be carried, dropped or given to a friend, and whoever places it gets the contents.
